Container.Name: lantern
Container.Overview: A guiding light for when you go dark. Automatically passes your chosen secrets to family members, inside 1Password.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: 1password dead man switch vault family self-hosted open source free
Container.Requires: 1Password family account and a service account token.

Config.Name: Token
Config.Description: 1Password service account token with allow creation of new vaults permission only.

Config.Name: Run token
Config.Description: Shared secret. Any long random string. You must send this token when calling POST /run.

Config.Name: Vault title
Config.Description: Name of vaults Lantern will create.

Config.Name: Inactive after days
Config.Description: Days without a 1Password login before a user's vault is shared. Warnings for the last 3 days. Valid values: 7-365.

Config.Name: Test day
Config.Description: Test the system without waiting. It pretends every member has been idle that many days. Put a dummy item in your Lantern vault. 87 is a warning (3 days left). 90 shares anyone who has items. Leave it empty when you are done.

Config.Name: Ping URL
Config.Description: Get notified if the container stops running by setting PING_URL to an external service like healthchecks.io. A successful run pings the URL. Leave empty to skip.

Config.Name: Auto run
Config.Description: Automatically call run on start and every 24 hours. Set `false` if you only use a scheduler like n8n. No notifications unless something externally calls POST /run.
